about: Audience Preview calibration set. 'expect' labels are AI-assisted draft labels (labelled_by: draft-ai), not survey data: the direction a typical Indian reader would lean (believe / mixed / doubt). 'tune' marks the posts used while changing wording; the others are held out.

posts.text:
2025 in milk, by the numbers 🥛

You drank 3.1 crore litres of Gaay Fresh milk this year. That's a lot of chai. Pune ordered the most paneer (sorry, Mumbai), and one Nashik family bought ghee every single day of the year. We see you.

Thank you for an udderly great year! Figures are from our own orders, January to November 2025.
